final.result:
I can't say yet whether Ostrich is a good fit, because nothing we have tested matches your data.

- **Your archives** (from `telemetry-archives.md`) are protobuf-encoded binary frames, 40–300 MB per file.
- **The Ostrich evidence** comes from our earlier research note on the project wiki's Ostrich benchmark (March 2026). Ostrich 0.9 got 4.1x, but only on text log files under 1 MB, on one core. That benchmark didn't test binary payloads or files over 1 MB.

Don't assume you'll get 4.1x. Protobuf binary is usually much denser than text logs, so the ratio will probably be lower. Throughput on files of hundreds of MB is also unknown.

Before deciding, run Ostrich on a few real archive files and compare ratio and speed against zstd as a baseline.
